# AI Supermarket

> A hand-curated directory of 213 AI tools organized into 21 industry departments — from marketing and design to law and healthcare. Every listing links to the tool's official website with a one-line description and pricing model (free / freemium / paid). Free to browse, no account needed. Last updated: 2026-09-09.

## Pages

- [AI Supermarket](https://ai.toolboxes.top/): browse and search all AI tools by department
- [About](https://ai.toolboxes.top/about): curation policy and contact
- [Privacy Policy](https://ai.toolboxes.top/privacy)
